notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Rebirth

 Introducing Rebirth! When you reach a pre determined number of hatches in your current life you will gain the ability to rebirth resetting your current upgrades and hatches in exchange for rebirth tokens to purchase upgrades that don't reset during future rebirths!


Offline Profit

 You now will gain hatches while you're offline! There is a max time though, with the base being 1 hour. But maybe theres way(s) to increase it.


Achievement Value Rework

 An achievement wasn't function as I originally though so its values have been modified slightly. But which one? 
 There was also a value error with another achievement that has been fixed


Other

 A lot of code reworks have been done in order to accommodate the new system. I probably should have just done it correctly the first time but whats the fun in that?

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Village

 Your village is expanding. Multiple upgrades have been made to appear in your village when total purchased is a multiple of 25.


Golden Penguins

 Keep an eye on the main screen. You may see a rare golden penguin. Make sure you click it quickly!


Upgrades

 8 new upgrades have been added to the game!
 Water Well
 Water Slide
 Ice Blocks
 Fish Friends
 Pebbles
 Fishing Boat
 Toboggan
 Floating Arm Bands


Moving Penguins

 Trying to make the village more lively the spawned penguins will move randomly!


Other

 More backend cleanup work (I know this if your favourite part of the update)

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Penguins

 Having multiples of 25 of a specific upgrade will add penguins to your village on the main screen!


Achievements

 Added 1 new achievement!


New Stat

 Added play time to the stats page! (Previous play time will be included)


Bulk Buying

 Buttons were added to the shop to allow for buying multiple upgrades at once!


Reset Button

 Added a button in settings where you can reset your current save data!


Other

 More background code cleanup (I know you still don't care)

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
New Additions

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug with the screen display when changing from Fullscreen to Windowed


Other

Cleaned up some code (I know you don't care)
